thesis: Context-qualified queries routed on UNscoped state: a contradiction raised in ctx_scoped blocked the same item in other contexts (false holds), and a supersede scoped to ctx_new revoked a globally-formed state in every context (false proceed). The historical router had no context dimension.
defect_class_locations: R7 (context-scoped contradiction) and R10 (context-scoped supersede revoking global state); R7/R10 introduced this class; R1-R6, R8, R9 unrelated to it.
